sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- During Escape from Tarkov's 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025 Christmas Celebration this item spawned throughout Tarkov and was used as a crafting item in the Christmas Tree module in the Hideout.
- In 2024 it also became a part of Escape from Tarkov: Arenas's Christmas Celebration.
